description.zh:
备份网关ID。

> - **SourceEndpoint**.**InstanceType**为**agent**时，该参数必传。
> - 如何创建备份网关，请参见[添加备份网关](~~93250~~)。
> - 您可以通过[DescribeBackupGatewayList](~~2869840~~)查看已有备份网关列表。
description.en:
The ID of the backup gateway.

> - This parameter is required if **SourceEndpoint**.**InstanceType** is set to **agent**.
>
> - For more information about how to create a backup gateway, see [Add a backup gateway](~~93250~~).
>
> - You can call the [DescribeBackupGatewayList](~~2869840~~) operation to view the list of existing backup gateways.

description.zh:
增量时间间隔，以秒（s）为单位。
> 仅选择**物理备份**时需要传入该参数。
description.en:
The interval for incremental backups, in seconds.

> This parameter is required only for **physical backups**.

description.zh:
备份方式，取值：
- **logical**：逻辑备份
- **physical**：物理备份
description.en:
The backup method. Valid values:

- **logical**: logical backup

- **physical**: physical backup

description.zh: 备份对象。
description.en: The backup objects.

description.zh:
全量备份周期，取值：
- **Monday**：周一
- **Tuesday**：周二
- **Wednesday**：周三
- **Thursday**：周四
- **Friday**：周五
- **Saturday**：周六
- **Sunday**：周日

> 支持选择多个取值，用英文逗号（,）分开。
description.en:
The full backup cycle. Valid values:

- **Monday**

- **Tuesday**

- **Wednesday**

- **Thursday**

- **Friday**

- **Saturday**

- **Sunday**

> You can select multiple values. Separate them with commas (,).

description.zh: 备份计划ID。
description.en: The ID of the backup plan.

description.zh: 自定义备份计划名称。
description.en: The custom name of the backup plan.

description.zh:
网络带宽限制，单位为KB/s，最大允许10 GB。
> 该参数仅对MySQL物理备份生效。
description.en:
The network bandwidth throttling limit, in KB/s. The maximum allowed value is 10 GB.

> This parameter is valid only for MySQL physical backups.

description.zh: 备份数据保留时间，取值：0~1825，默认为730天。
description.en: The retention period for backup data, in days. Valid values: 0 to 1825. Default value: 730.

description.zh:
磁盘IO限制， 单位为KB/s。
> 该参数仅对MySQL物理备份生效。
description.en:
The disk I/O limit, in KB/s.

> This parameter is valid only for MySQL physical backups.

description.zh: 全量备份开始时间，格式为HH:mm（UTC时间）。
description.en: The start time for the full backup. The time is in the *HH:mm* format and is in UTC.

description.zh:
内置存储类型：
- 空（默认）：备份数据存储在用户OSS上。
- system ：备份数据存储在DBS的内置OSS上。
description.en:
The built-in storage type:

- Empty (default): Backup data is stored in your OSS bucket.

- system: Backup data is stored in the built-in OSS bucket of DBS.

description.zh:
全量备份周期，取值：
- **simple**：周期备份，和BackupPeriod、BackupStartTime配合使用。
- **manual**：手动备份。

> 默认为**simple**。
description.en:
The full backup strategy. Valid values:

- **simple**: periodic backup. Use this value with BackupPeriod and BackupStartTime.

- **manual**: manual backup.

> The default value is **simple**.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。
description.en: A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. This prevents duplicate requests.

description.zh: 跨阿里云账号备份的UID。
description.en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account for cross-account backup.

description.zh: 跨阿里云账号备份的RAM角色名称。
description.en: The name of the RAM role for cross-account backup.

description.zh: 数据库地域。
description.en: The region where the database is located.

description.zh:
数据库类型，取值：
- **MySQL**
- **MSSQL**
- **Oracle**
- **MariaDB**
- **PostgreSQL**
- **DRDS**
- **MongoDB**
- **Redis**
description.en:
The database type. Valid values:

- **MySQL**

- **MSSQL**

- **Oracle**

- **MariaDB**

- **PostgreSQL**

- **DRDS**

- **MongoDB**

- **Redis**

description.zh: 转为归档冷备存储时间，默认为365天。
description.en: The time after which backup data is converted to archive storage, in days. Default value: 365.

description.zh: 转为低频访问存储时间，默认为180天。
description.en: The time after which backup data is converted to Infrequent Access (IA) storage, in days. Default value: 180.

description.zh:
是否开启增量日志备份，取值：
- **true**：开启
- **false**：关闭
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable incremental log backup. Valid values:

- **true**

- **false**

description.zh: 用于备注请求来源，默认值为OpenApi，无需手动设置。
description.en: The source of the request. The default value is OpenApi. You do not need to set this parameter.

description.zh:
备份计划的规格，取值：
- **micro**
- **small**
- **medium**
- **large**
- **xlarge**

> 规格越高，备份与恢复的性能越高。更多信息，请参见[规格说明](~~84372~~)。
description.en:
The specification of the backup plan. Valid values:

- **micro**

- **small**

- **medium**

- **large**

- **xlarge**

> Higher specifications provide better backup and recovery performance. For more information, see [Specifications](~~84372~~).

description.zh:
数据库实例类型，取值：
- **RDS**
- **PolarDB**
- **DDS**：阿里云MongoDB
- **Kvstore**：阿里云Redis
- **Other**：通过IP:Port接入的数据库
- **dg**：无公网IP:Port的自建数据库（通过数据库网关DG接入）
description.en:
The database instance type. Valid values:

- **RDS**

- **PolarDB**

- **DDS**: Alibaba Cloud MongoDB

- **Kvstore**: Alibaba Cloud Redis

- **Other**: A database connected over an IP address and port.

- **dg**: A self-managed database without a public IP address or port, connected through Database Gateway (DG).

description.zh:
OSS Bucket名称。
默认：系统自动生成新的名称。
description.en:
The name of the Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket.
Default: The system automatically generates a new name.

description.zh:
支付方式，取值：

 **prepay**：预付费（包年包月）
description.en:
The payment method. Valid value:

**prepay**: subscription

description.zh:
指定预付费实例为包年或者包月类型，取值：
- **Year**：包年
- **Month**：包月
description.en:
The billing cycle of the subscription instance. Valid values:

- **Year**

- **Month**

description.zh: DBS支持地域，可调用[DescribeRegions](~~2869853~~)接口查看。
description.en: The region where DBS is available. To view the available regions, call the [DescribeRegions](~~2869853~~) operation.

description.zh: 资源组ID。
description.en: The ID of the resource group.

description.zh:
数据库名称。

> 数据库类型为**PostgreSQL**、**MongoDB**时，该参数必传。
description.en:
The database name.

> This parameter is required if the database type is **PostgreSQL** or **MongoDB**.

description.zh:
数据库连接地址。

> **SourceEndpoint**.**InstanceType**为**express**、**agent**、**other**时，该参数必传。
description.en:
The database endpoint.

> This parameter is required if **SourceEndpoint**.**InstanceType** is set to **express**, **agent**, or **other**.

description.zh:
数据库实例ID。

> **SourceEndpoint**.**InstanceType**为**RDS**、**ECS**、**DDS**、**Express**时，该参数必传。
description.en:
The ID of the database instance.

> This parameter is required if **SourceEndpoint**.**InstanceType** is set to **RDS**, **ECS**, **DDS**, or **Express**.

description.zh:
数据库所在位置，取值：
- **RDS**
- **ECS**
- **Express**：通过专线/VPN网关/智能网关接入的数据库
- **Agent**：通过备份网关接入的数据库
- **DDS**：云MongoDB
- **Other**：通过IP:Port直连的数据库
- **dg**：无公网IP:Port的自建数据库（通过数据库网关DG接入）
description.en:
The location of the database. Valid values:

- **RDS**

- **ECS**

- **Express**: A database connected through a leased line, VPN Gateway, or Smart Access Gateway.

- **Agent**: A database connected through a backup gateway.

- **DDS**: Alibaba Cloud MongoDB

- **Other**: A database connected directly over an IP address and port.

- **dg**: A self-managed database without a public IP address or port, connected through Database Gateway (DG).

description.zh: Oracle SID名称，数据库类型为Oracle时，该参数必传。
description.en: The Oracle system ID (SID). This parameter is required if the database type is Oracle.

description.zh:
密码。

> 数据库类型为**Redis**，或者数据库所在位置为**agent**且数据库类型为**MSSQL**时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传。
description.en:
The password for the database account.

> This parameter is optional if the database type is **Redis**, or if the database location is **agent** and the database type is **MSSQL**. In all other cases, this parameter is required.

description.zh:
数据库端口。

> **SourceEndpoint**.**InstanceType**为**express**、**agent**、**other**、**ECS**时，该参数必传。
description.en:
The database port.

> This parameter is required if **SourceEndpoint**.**InstanceType** is set to **express**, **agent**, **other**, or **ECS**.

description.zh:
数据库地域。
> **SourceEndpoint**.**InstanceType**为**RDS**、**ECS**、**DDS**、**Express**、**Agent**时，该参数必传。
description.en:
The region where the database is located.

> This parameter is required if **SourceEndpoint**.**InstanceType** is set to **RDS**, **ECS**, **DDS**, **Express**, or **Agent**.

description.zh:
数据库账号。

> 数据库类型为**Redis**，或者数据库所在位置为**agent**且数据库类型为**MSSQL**时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传。
description.en:
The database account.

> This parameter is optional if the database type is **Redis**, or if the database location is **agent** and the database type is **MSSQL**. In all other cases, this parameter is required.

description.zh: 存储地域。
description.en: The storage region.

description.zh: 该参数暂未开放使用。
description.en: This parameter is not yet available.

description.zh:
指定购买时长，取值：
- 当参数**Period**为**Year**时，**UsedTime**取值为1~5。
- 当参数**Period**为**Month**时，**UsedTime**取值为1~11。
description.en:
The subscription duration. Valid values:

- If **Period** is set to **Year**, the value of **UsedTime** can be 1 to 5.

- If **Period** is set to **Month**, the value of **UsedTime** can be 1 to 11.

descriptions.zh: 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解数据库备份DBS产品的[收费方式和价格](~~70005~~)。
descriptions.en: Before you call this operation, ensure that you understand the [billing methods and pricing](~~70005~~) of Database Backup (DBS).
